changes.title: Cancelled statistics tours
changes.text: A cancelled statistics tour can no longer replace your own statistics after its background loading finishes.

changes.title: Sample data lifecycle
changes.text: Sample preparation and cleanup now run in sequence, retaining the safeguards that protect genuine run history.

changes.title: Tour cancellation regressions
changes.text: Added controlled background-worker tests proving cancelled tours stay cancelled and current tours still open.

changes.title: Verified build evidence
changes.text: Recorded the preceding build's successful checks and Android screenshots, alongside remaining testing and execution limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I fixed a race that could reopen sample statistics after a tour was cancelled. Genuine history, statistics calculations and the current tour's normal behavior remain unchanged.
